Show the most used string methods on one string.

Supplied answer
a = " I am Suryakanta "
print(a.strip()) # removes spaces from both ends
print(a.lower()) # small letters
print(a.upper()) # capital letters
print(a.title()) # I Am Suryakanta
print(a.capitalize()) # only first letter capital
print(a.swapcase()) # upper <-> lower
print(a.replace("am", "was"))
print(a.split()) # list of words
print(a.strip().count("a"))
print(a.find("am")) # index, or -1 if not found
print(len(a), "am" in a)
Note: String methods never change the original string; they return a new one.
